summary: Completed Module 04 Step 5 BREAK: diagnosed IDOR vulnerability where cross-tenant GET /links/:id returned HTTP 200 instead of HTTP 404.
evidence: Observed regression failure: GET /links/:id (Tenant B) returned HTTP 200 containing Tenant A confidential long_url instead of 404.
Formulated root-cause hypothesis: link.service.ts or controller performed unscoped findUnique query on id alone without scoping to tenantId.
